overview.brief: Rugged Karana plains stretch with passes and river crossings; connects to North Karana, Highpass Hold, and Gorge of King Xorbb. Lions, spiders, bandits, gnolls; upper end griffins, evil eyes, cyclopes, hill giants, treants. EQ Legends Tools recommends 8–20.
